content:
Nora Kim: Heads-up - short isolation for customer 'Meridian' on-prem callers around 02:15 UTC, ~2.5m of 504s.
incident-bot: Alert: PEER_CONN_DRIFT tenant=Meridian at 2026-11-29T02:15:10Z (ticket INC-8934)
Sam Weller: Flow logs show SNAT reassignment while routes reprogrammed. Signature similar to earlier SNAT race incidents.
Ibrahim Khan: Their edge runs bootstrap v1.3.8 with default conntrack (small table). SE-Maya says limited conntrack and older kernel.
Tess O'Neill: Immediate plan: 1) give customer a temp sticky-SNAT snippet and conntrack guidance, 2) schedule maintenance to update bootstrap, 3) platform durability change.
SE-Maya: Meridian can apply temp config today but needs rollback notes.
Nora Kim: Owners and actions:
- Sam: Create DED-4310 with snippet + runbook (ETA today 6h)
- Ibrahim: Prototype peering controller debounce (tenant feature-flag) branch peering/debounce-meridian (ETA 4d)
- Tess: Arrange maintenance window and confirm appliance inventory (ETA 48h)
- Nora: Add to recurring incidents tracker and set 30-day watch cadence (ETA today)
Sam Weller: DED-4310 link added with snippet and rollback steps.
Ibrahim Khan: Debounce idea: 25s hold after peer-change, preserve SNAT mappings; will include CLI override for quick revert. Will emit metrics peering.debounce_applied.
Tess O'Neill: Add CI test that simulates route churn and validates >95% session continuity. I'll coordinate infra for a test job.
Nora Kim: Recurrence note: this is second similar event for Meridian in 70 days. If another occurs within 90 days, escalate to a remediation sprint.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: meridian-remediation-checkin every Mon 18:00 UTC for 4 weeks starting 2026-12-06
SE-Maya: Meridian applied the temp SNAT and will monitor. Will share conntrack stats after 24h.
Sam Weller: I'll paste flow excerpt and links into DED-4310 and REC tracker.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll open PR and mark it WIP. Keep Monday check-ins until 30 days clean.
Nora Kim: Thanks team. If another flap happens, escalate immediately. End thread.
